label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Aaron Rai Confirmed for Memorial
items.text: Aaron Rai, fresh off a PGA Championship win at Aronimink with a final-round 65, is officially confirmed for the 2026 Memorial Tournament at Muirfield Village June 1–7.

items.headline: Wyndham Clark Wins CJ CUP Byron Nelson
items.text: Wyndham Clark shot an 11-under 60 to win the CJ CUP Byron Nelson at 30-under 254, beating Si Woo Kim by three shots for his fifth PGA Tour victory.

items.headline: Scheffler Frustration Sparks Fan Anger
items.text: Scottie Scheffler slammed his driver twice into the turf at the 13th tee during the Byron Nelson final round, drawing angry reactions from fans while chasing Clark.
